notes: Caller for the ICD-9 branch (dx_codetype=09) of the %classify_dx macro. The 16 diagnosis codes are real ICD-9 codes taken directly from the macro's if-then lists (e.g. 0103->pulresp, 0420->immuno/progressive, 2500->endo, 4100->cardiac/progressive, 7490->cranio, V08->immuno). Each is classified into exactly one body system matching the system its if-then assignment specifies. Uses DATALINES so no external file is needed.
